text:
anya: FYI console alarm: EU-1 hourly rehydrates jumped to ~18k queued overnight. Could be duplicate enqueue or late ingest.
devon: Confirmed spike at 02:12 UTC, replayers hit 95% CPU and a few OOMs. Autoscaler reacted but was slow.
matt: Anyone kicked a backfill or migration?
lia: No manual backfills. Suspect new dedupe behavior + reduced retry backoff from replay service caused retries to spawn rehydrates.
anya: Cost alert is on. We should limit new rehydrate submissions to avoid saturating dedicated pools while we triage.
devon: Proposal: add background lane for non-urgent reprocesses + per-tenant token bucket so one tenant can't soak capacity.
matt: Also add small API extension: X-Reprocess-Priority header and X-Dry-Run to return cost/ETA before enqueue.
lia: Console needs syncing. Keep default behavior to preserve compatibility and introduce header behind feature flag.
anya: Agreed. Default priority remains interactive; feature flag enables background lane.
devon: Dashboard will need to show lane breakdown; otherwise totals will be misleading.
matt: UI: two cards: Queued (interactive) and Queued (background) with SLA tooltips.
ops-bot: replayer: 03:10 spike - 4 worker OOMs, autoscale triggered :warning:
anya: Throttle plan: token-per-tenant at API ingress for background lane, global refill per cluster and daily tenant caps. 429 when exceeded.
devon: Implementation: Redis leaky-bucket key tenant:{id}:rehydration:tokens, config refill_rate and burst. Metrics: tokens_granted, tokens_denied.
matt: Console dry-run flow: POST /v1/reprocess?dry_run=true -> {tokens_needed, cost_estimate_usd, est_minutes, confidence}. Show modal with priority selector and sample-only toggle.
lia: API sketch in console docs. We'll also add sample-only run (10%) to verify outputs.
devon: Add operator endpoint to move queued jobs between lanes for emergencies. Emit audit events for reprocess creation.
anya: Rollout: backend + console flags. Start routing 5% of background requests for 24h, monitor queue depth, deny rate, and cost.
matt: UX: show dry_run confidence and link to sampling details.
lia: Telemetry: add panels for lane_breakdown, per_tenant_token_usage, dry_run_accuracy. Alert on high deny_rate or lane_queue_depth thresholds.
devon: I'll implement server changes and operator endpoint. Anya will do token bucket + metrics, Matt will do console modal, Lia updates dashboards.
ops-bot: deploy-bot created replayer-v2-canary in eu-1 for autoscale fixes.
anya: I'll run a top-10 tenants-by-queued query and DM owners now. Post results here. :thumbsup:
